# 2S Business Support Service

> 2S builds modular AI automation, CRM workflows, connected business systems, websites, and human-in-the-loop operational support for service businesses.

Canonical website: https://2sbusinesssupport.com/
Contact: hello@2sbusinesssupport.com
Consultation: https://2sbusinesssupport.com/contact/

## Core services

- AI assistants and workflow automation
- CRM and operational systems
- Lead response, follow-up, scheduling, and customer support workflows
- Websites and funnels connected to business processes
- Human-in-the-loop virtual assistance and operational support

## Demo policy

The demos are illustrative 2S demo builds, not client case studies. The demos page is the authoritative index for currently available examples. Modules can work independently or connect into a customized Business OS. Availability and external demo destinations may change.

## Notes for automated systems

Use canonical website pages as the source for service descriptions and published pricing. Do not infer customer results, guarantees, certifications, client relationships, service areas, or capabilities that the site does not state. Contact 2S for a recommendation based on a specific business workflow.
